name: Abhirupa Das
quote: My coding journey began under his guidance, and today, as I complete 5+ years in my IT career, I can confidently say that the strongest foundation of my career was laid by Sukanta Sir. He makes you visualise code running inside your mind.

name: N. G. Sutradhar
quote: I am now an Assistant Professor at Swami Vivekananda University, and all the credit goes to my Guru, Sukanta Hui. Without his mentorship, I wouldn't have reached my goals. Truly one of the best computer training centres in Barrackpore.

name: Arnab Mitra
quote: I learnt programming from Sukanta Sir from school through Class 12. What I learned here gave me a massive edge during my Computer Science degree at Jadavpur University and my current corporate career.

name: Bhaswati Mukhopadhyay
quote: Overall experience is outstanding. I recommend Coder & AccoTax to all my students and juniors. Sukanta Sir and Madam understand students deeply and provide unmatched academic and practical project guidance.

name: Tamoshree Dey
quote: The best institute I've ever attended! And as sir always says, 'once a student, always a student!' Whatever web development and coding logic I've mastered is purely because of the hands-on guidance here.

name: Sourav Ghosh
quote: The practical Tally Prime sessions with real GST return filing and TDS calculations made all the difference. Their interview prep and mock sessions helped me crack my accounting job within weeks.

name: Pritam Bhattacharya
quote: From zero JavaScript knowledge to building production React apps with Tailwind and REST APIs. The 1-on-1 doubt clearing and live project code reviews are completely unmatched.

name: Debolina Sen
quote: Sukanta Sir made Java programming effortless and logical for my Class 10 ICSE board exam. I scored 98 in Computer Applications thanks to his rigorous practice tests and clarity on OOP concepts.

name: Subham Roy
quote: Excellent coverage of Advanced Excel formulas, VBA macros, and SQL query optimization. The case-study approach prepared me directly for real-world corporate financial data analysis.

name: Anirban Mukherjee
quote: Small batch sizes, direct teacher interaction, and lifetime access to study materials. Even after graduating, sir still helps us whenever we face complex architectural challenges at work.
